title: Warm Weeknight Crunchy Norwegian Natto Stir-fry
description: A quick and nutritious stir-fry featuring the funky fermented soybeans natto, crunchy veggies, and a touch of Norwegian flair, all cooked in a single mason jar. Perfect for a busy weeknight dinner that's also ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly.
instructions: Add a small amount of water to the mason jar and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Add the natto and mix to loosen the fermented soybeans with a spatula.
Add the mixed nori seaweed sheets on top of the natto and mix to combine.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the mason jar and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chopped cabbage, carrots, and green onions to the mason jar and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Remove the mason jar from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional seaweed sheets if desired.
